qualifier: integrin and syndecan cell-surface interactions
name: Stromal extracellular matrix with integrin and syndecan adhesion
rationale: Members are fibroblast/stromal ECM, EMT and cell adhesion programmes; unlike confusables built on collagen degradation, fibronectin assembly or YAP mechanosignalling, this theme carries integrin and syndecan cell-surface interactions and stromal fibroblast markers.

core: Negative feedback control of MAPK signaling
qualifier: ERK1/2 dephosphorylation coupled to AP-1 and IL-6 signaling
name: MAPK phosphatase feedback on ERK, AP-1 and IL-6 signaling
rationale: Members concern dephosphorylation-mediated suppression of ERK, JNK and p38 cascades with their AP-1 and IL-6/STAT3 outputs, distinguishing it from confusables about TAK1-driven stress kinase activation, immediate-early genes or ERK5/atypical MAPKs.

qualifier: bone marrow proliferation and survival
name: Hematopoietic stem cell homeostasis and bone marrow cell numbers
rationale: All members regulate HSC self-renewal, proliferation, differentiation or survival in bone marrow; confusables instead centre on thymocytes, general stem-cell/LIF maintenance or lineage-specific differentiation blocks.

qualifier: dolichol, mannose-phosphate and Golgi processing defects
name: N-glycosylation disorders of dolichol, mannose supply and Golgi processing
rationale: All members are CDGs of the N-glycan pathway caused by defects in dolichol synthesis (DOLK, SRD5A3), mannose-phosphate supply (MPI, PMM2), LLO flipping/utilisation (RFT1, MPDU1) or Golgi trimming (MGAT2, B4GALT1), unlike confusables of DPM/GDP-mannose, ALG glycosyltransferase or GPI-anchor defects.

core: IL-12 family and IL-17 cytokine immunity
qualifier: C-type lectin antifungal sensing
name: Dectin-driven antifungal immunity with IL-12-family and IL-17 cytokines
rationale: Members combine Dectin-1/Dectin-2/DC-SIGN antifungal lectin signalling with IL-12/23/27/35, IL-10, IL-17 and IL-20/36/38 cytokine signalling and production; confusables lack the lectin arm and instead carry IL-18, IL-33/type III interferon or protozoan/TLR responses.

qualifier: by nuclear intracellular domain rather than receptor processing
name: Nuclear Notch intracellular domain target gene transcription
rationale: Members describe NICD1-4-driven transcription, its stabilisation by PEST/FBXW7 defects and its regulators, whereas confusables cover Notch receptor proteolytic activation and signal transmission to the nucleus.

qualifier: hyaluronan turnover and ectodomain shedding
name: Extracellular matrix degradation with hyaluronan turnover and ectodomain shedding
rationale: Members cover collagen, elastin and hyaluronan catabolism with protease and shedding control and scavenger receptors; confusables instead emphasise collagen/elastic fibre synthesis or fibrinolysis and integrin adhesion.

qualifier: FGFR1 and FGFR2 isoforms
name: FGFR1 and FGFR2 ligand activation and downstream adaptor cascades
rationale: Members are ligand binding and FRS/SHC/PI3K/PLC-gamma cascades of FGFR1 and FGFR2 (plus activating FGFR mutants), distinguishing it from confusables built around FGFR3 and FGFR2 splicing variants.

qualifier: fibrinolysis and integrin adhesion
name: Extracellular matrix degradation, fibrinolysis and integrin adhesion
rationale: Members combine MMP/collagen/elastin degradation, plasminogen activation and fibrin clot dissolution with integrin adhesion; confusables add contact-activation/kallikrein or hyaluronan turnover instead.

qualifier: proximal PLCG1, RAS, PI3K and FRS2 effectors
name: TRKB activation by neurotrophins and proximal adaptor signaling
rationale: All members are BDNF/NT-3/NT-4 activation of NTRK2 and its immediate effector branches, unlike confusables on TRKB CDK5/RAC1 or synaptic output, TRKC, or NGF/TRKA signalling.

qualifier: fatty acid and aquaglyceroporin glycerol transport
name: Adipose thermogenesis with fatty acid and aquaglyceroporin glycerol transport
rationale: Members link cold- and diet-induced thermogenesis and fatty acid cycling to aquaporin glycerol/urea transport out of adipocytes, while confusables centre on adipocyte differentiation or water transport.

qualifier: neutrophil antimicrobial granule programme
name: Granulocyte differentiation and neutrophil antimicrobial granule programme
rationale: Members cover neutrophil, eosinophil and mast cell differentiation, G-CSF/GM-CSF responses and the maturing neutrophil granule cargo, unlike confusables centred on M-CSF/macrophage or RUNX1/erythroid-megakaryocytic programmes.

qualifier: mating, parental, aggressive and drinking behavior
name: Innate social, reproductive and drinking behaviors
rationale: Members are instinctive behaviours (male/female mating, parental, aggressive, drinking and ethanol-related), distinguishing it from confusables on sleep/wake, stress/fear responses or reproductive physiology.

qualifier: postsynaptic glutamate receptor clustering and short-term plasticity
name: Postsynaptic glutamate receptor clustering and excitatory synaptic strength
rationale: Members concern AMPA receptor clustering, diffusion trapping and postsynaptic localisation with resulting synaptic potentiation and sensory gating, unlike confusables on receptor activation/LTP, receptor trafficking or presynaptic release.

qualifier: aromatic amino acids, histidine, threonine and proline
name: Catabolism of aromatic amino acids, histidine, threonine and proline
rationale: Members are degradation and interconversion of phenylalanine/tyrosine, histidine, threonine, proline and glycine/glyoxylate; confusables add glutamate/aspartate, conjugation or BH4 metabolism and lack histidine catabolism.

qualifier: assembly and ubiquitin-independent degradation in cross-presentation
name: Proteasome assembly and ubiquitin-independent degradation for cross-presentation
rationale: Members concern proteasome assembly and ubiquitin/ATP-independent proteasomal degradation feeding endosomal cross-presentation and CD8 T cell homeostasis; confusables cover ubiquitin-dependent degradation, viral receptor downregulation or MHC I loading.

qualifier: with hair cycle, melanocyte and sebaceous niches
name: Keratinocyte proliferation-differentiation control in epidermis and pilosebaceous unit
rationale: Members regulate keratinocyte proliferation, differentiation and apoptosis together with anagen, melanocyte and sebaceous gland development; confusables focus on wound re-epithelialisation, cornification, nail/hair follicle morphogenesis or MITF pigmentation.

qualifier: synaptic vesicles and postsynaptic receptors
name: Endosomal recycling of synaptic vesicles and postsynaptic receptors
rationale: Members cover endosome-based synaptic vesicle recycling and postsynaptic receptor internalisation/localisation, unlike confusables on clathrin endocytosis machinery, postsynaptic assembly or synaptic structural plasticity.

qualifier: transamination, glycine conjugation and gluconeogenic carbon
name: Amino acid transamination, catabolism and glycine conjugation
rationale: Members span glutamate/glutamine, aspartate, alanine, aromatic, glycine, proline and threonine metabolism with glycine/glutamine conjugation and gluconeogenesis; confusables instead carry urea cycle, sulfur/serine/glutathione, selenium or TCA shuttle pathways.

qualifier: angiotensin generation and kinin peptide degradation
name: Angiotensin generation and kinin degradation in blood pressure control
rationale: Members concern angiotensinogen processing, angiotensin signalling and bradykinin/neuropeptide catabolism raising arterial pressure, unlike confusables on renal natriuresis, glomerular filtration or vasodilation.

qualifier: cornified barrier and appendage formation
name: Epidermal differentiation, cornified barrier and ectodermal appendage development
rationale: Members cover keratinocyte differentiation, cornification and barrier formation plus hair follicle, nail, sebaceous, mammary and taste papilla development; confusables concern tooth development, melanocyte pigmentation or intestinal epithelium.

qualifier: initiation, elongation and termination steps
name: Mitochondrial translation initiation, elongation and termination
rationale: All members are the steps of mitoribosomal translation, distinct from confusables on mitochondrial RNA processing, tRNA aminoacylation, transcription or respiratory complex assembly.

qualifier: cargo sorting and basal body docking rather than intraflagellar transport
name: Ciliary membrane cargo targeting and basal body docking
rationale: Members cover BBSome, ARL13B, VxPx and myristoyl-mediated cargo delivery to the cilium, transition-zone localisation and basal body anchoring, unlike confusables on intraflagellar transport or photoreceptor outer segments.

qualifier: all three polymerases, including HIV Tat elongation and rRNA gene control
name: Core transcription cycle of RNA polymerases I, II and III
rationale: Members describe initiation, promoter escape, elongation, pausing and termination by Pol I, II and III, including HIV-1 Tat elongation and rDNA chromatin control, unlike confusables on RNA splicing/processing, Pol II termination or translation.

qualifier: nicotinic receptors and acetylcholine release
name: Nicotinic cholinergic transmission and acetylcholine release
rationale: Members are nicotinic acetylcholine receptor signalling, acetylcholine synthesis/secretion and neuromuscular transmission, distinct from confusables on choline transport, muscarinic/serotonin GPCRs or NMJ assembly.
